stem.en: What is special about the energy of the lowest possible state of a quantum harmonic oscillator?
stem.et: Mis on eriline kvantharmoonilise ostsillaatori madalaima võimaliku oleku energia juures?

label.en: It is nonzero — a zero-point energy of ħω/2 — even though this is the lowest energy the system can have
label.et: See on nullist erinev — nullpunktienergia ħω/2 —, kuigi see on madalaim energia, mis süsteemil saab olla

label.en: It is exactly zero, matching a classical oscillator sitting motionless at the bottom of the well
label.et: See on täpselt null, vastates klassikalisele ostsillaatorile, mis seisab liikumatult augu põhjas

label.en: It is negative, lower than the potential energy minimum itself
label.et: See on negatiivne, madalam kui potentsiaalse energia miinimum ise

label.en: It depends on the amplitude of oscillation chosen by the experimenter
label.et: See sõltub eksperimenteerija valitud võnkumise amplituudist
